description:
The configuration profile titled “Home Screen Layout” (PayloadIdentifier com.example.profile.homescreen) has been prepared for Example Corp. It is identified by the UUID 123E4567‑E89B‑12D3‑A456‑426614174000, uses the payload type com.apple.homescreenlayout, and is version 1 of the profile. This payload will apply a standardized arrangement to all managed iOS devices, ensuring a consistent user experience across the organization.

The dock will contain the Mail application (Bundle ID com.apple.mobilemail) and a folder named “Utilities”. Inside Utilities you will find the Calculator app (Bundle ID com.apple.calculator) and another folder called “Notes Folder”. On the home screen pages, the first page will feature the Maps app (Bundle ID com.apple.maps) and a folder labeled “Games”. The Games folder holds the Sudoku application (Bundle ID com.apple.sudoku). This layout matches the requested design while preserving the original naming and bundle identifiers.
